evidence.evidence_text: We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments, where RAFTS can outperform GPT-based methods with a significantly smaller 7B LLM.
To combat misinformation, large language models (LLMs) are adapted to automatically verify claim credibility.
Combined with informative in-context examples as prior, RAFTS achieves significant improvements to supervised and LLM baselines without complex prompts.
The rapid propagation of misinformation poses substantial risks to public interest.
